question:
Select the option that correctly rectifies the underlined spelling error in the given sentence.

Little children are afraid to go to school because of the __agrassive__ seniors who tend to bully them.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"agressive"** is incorrect and not found in the dictionary. (गलत शब्द)

 
 
• **Example: **Incorrect: The dog was very agressive.
 
 
 
• **"Aggressive" **means ready or likely to attack or confront; characterized by or resulting from aggression. (आक्रामक)
 
 
• **Example: **The company has an **aggressive** marketing strategy to outperform its competitors.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the correct spelling is **'aggressive'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Aggresive** (गलत वर्तनी): Incorrect spelling of "aggressive".

 
 
• **Example:** Incorrect: He was very aggresive during the argument.
 
 
 
• **Agrresive** (गलत वर्तनी): Incorrect spelling of "aggressive".
 
 
• **Example: **Incorrect: The lion was agrresive in its territory.
 
 
 
• **Agrressive** (गलत वर्तनी): Incorrect spelling of "aggressive".
 
 
• **Example:** Incorrect: The child was agrressive towards his classmates.
